svg.title: P1's ratio to ΛCDM at MIT's two radii
svg.desc: R_l = C_l(P1)/C_l(LambdaCDM) at routes A and B from the frozen computation, beside the two estimates recorded before v1's freeze; the band marks R_l within 10 percent of 1. Theory only, no data.
